researchResults.name: Bellie (Vinyl Figure)
researchResults.description: Part of the 2010 GIANTmicrobes vinyl figure line (a departure from their usual plush), Bellie is a ~3.5" vinyl character inspired by a microscopic image of Shigella dysenteriae, the bacterium that causes stomach ache/dysentery. It shipped with a sticker and an animated flipbook.
researchResults.source: spacecartoonsafari.eu product page (Giant Microbes Vinyl figuur Bellie); corroborated by eBay listings ("Giant Microbes by Drew Oliver Bellie Vinyl Figure NIB", UPC 874665004952) and thegeektwins.com/theblotsays.com coverage of the 2010 GIANTmicrobes vinyl figure series
researchResults.notes: GIANTmicrobes still sells a related "Shouting Bellie" keychain today, but this vinyl-figure format (2010) is discontinued; the image is from a Dutch reseller (Space & Cartoon Safari) still stocking old inventory.

researchResults.name: Bird Flu Petri Dish
researchResults.description: A now-discontinued GIANTmicrobes "Petri Dish" accessory pack containing mini plush of Bird Flu (Influenza A virus H5N1, avian influenza), packaged in a small Petri-dish-style container with an educational card.
researchResults.source: Confirmed real via Wayback Machine snapshot of giantmicrobes.com/us/products/birdflu-petri.html (archived 2016-04-14) and an eBay listing from seller astro2go/"Astronomy To Go" titled "GIANT MICROBES-BIRD FLU PETRI DISH-Stuffed Plush Avian Fowl Influenza Virus H5N1"
researchResults.notes: Could not retrieve a direct image of the actual Petri-dish packaging (eBay/picclick pages for this specific listing kept timing out). The image_url provided is the standard standalone Bird Flu plush from NeatoShop (same character design used in the mini Petri-dish plush, but not confirmed to show the Petri-dish packaging itself).

researchResults.name: Black Ant Petri Dish
researchResults.description: GIANTmicrobes "Petri Dish" accessory pack containing 3 mini plush of the Black Ant (Lasius niger, the black garden ant), packaged in a Petri dish with an educational insert about ant biology and colony life.
researchResults.source: eBay listing (via PicClick) "GIANT MICROBES-BLACK ANT PETRI DISH-Stuffed Plush Formicidae Colony Queen Garden" (seller astro2go); confirmed real via Wayback Machine snapshot of giantmicrobes.com/us/products/blackant-petri.html (archived 2016-06-13) and French retailer scienceshopping.com listing ("GiantMicrobes - La fourmi noire - Boîte de Petri")

researchResults.name: Black Death Petri Dish
researchResults.description: GIANTmicrobes "Petri Dish" accessory pack containing mini plush of Black Death (Yersinia pestis), the bacterium responsible for the medieval bubonic plague pandemic, packaged in a Petri dish with an educational card.
researchResults.source: eBay listing (via PicClick UK) "GIANT MICROBES-BLACK DEATH PETRI DISH-Stuffed Plush Bubonic Plague Bacteria Flea" (seller astro2go, item 174630725839); confirmed real via Wayback Machine snapshot of giantmicrobes.com/us/products/blackdeath-petri.html (archived 2017-07-12)

researchResults.name: Black Death Primordial Putty

researchResults.source: Amazon.in listing "Giant Microbes Primordial Putty Death, Black" (ASIN B009UVRCWE); GIANTmicrobes Wiki (Fandom) "Primordial Putty" article; TrendHunter.com "Giant Microbes Primordial Putties" article; confirmed real via Wayback Machine snapshot of giantmicrobes.com/us/products/blackdeath-putty.html (archived 2015-09-05)

researchResults.source: Wayback Machine archive of giantmicrobes.com/us/products/eggcell-petri.html (snapshot 2017-07-11), title tag 'Egg Cell (Human ovum) petri dish' and meta description

researchResults.notes: No evidence GIANTmicrobes/riesenmikroben.de ever sold an Einstein-themed product. GIANTmicrobes' entire catalog (confirmed via their site categories, Wikipedia, and extensive search) consists only of microbes, cells, organs, and molecules/hormones -- never historical figures. Found no product page, cached snapshot, marketplace listing, or image for this item.

Same as einstein-3d-puzzle: no evidence this is a real GIANTmicrobes product. 'Einstein candle' matches The Unemployed Philosophers Guild's unrelated Einstein-themed candle/gift line, not GIANTmicrobes.

No evidence this is a real GIANTmicrobes product. An 'Albert Einstein Little Thinker' plush doll exists but is made by The Unemployed Philosophers Guild (philosophersguild.com), a completely different company. No GIANTmicrobes-branded Einstein doll found anywhere.

No evidence this is a real GIANTmicrobes product. Search results only surfaced unrelated 'Baby Einstein' (Kids II media franchise) puppets and Unemployed Philosophers Guild finger puppets, neither connected to GIANTmicrobes.
No evidence this is a real GIANTmicrobes product. A real 'Solar Einstein' figurine exists but is made by Kikkerland Design (designer Chris Collicott), an unrelated novelty company, not GIANTmicrobes.

GIANTmicrobes does sell an Estrogen hormone plush and does have a real earrings product line (Antibody, Heart, STI, Brain Cell, Blood Cells, Waterbear, Butterfly, COVID-19 earrings), making 'Estrogen Earrings' plausible in principle, but no product page, cached snapshot, image, or marketplace listing confirming this specific item's existence was found despite extensive targeted searching. Not confirmed, so reporting as not found rather than guessing.

researchResults.name: GIANTmicrobes(R) Original Set (Fall 2008 Release Pack)
researchResults.description: A seasonal multi-item bundle from GIANTmicrobes containing one of each doll from their Fall 2008 product release; sold as a collectible gift set (not tied to a single organism).
researchResults.source: Wayback Machine capture of giantmicrobes.com/us/products/fall-2008-pack.html (2008-11-06); meta description confirms 'Our Fall 2008 Release pack contains one of each new doll.' The page's only product image (productthumbnails2/fall-2008-tmb_02.jpg) was never archived by the crawler (404 in Wayback), and no other capture of that image file exists in the CDX index.
researchResults.notes: Name and description verified from the archived product page itself. No usable direct image URL could be found despite trying multiple Wayback timestamps/paths.

researchResults.name: Fat Cell Key Chain 12 Pack
researchResults.description: A 12-pack of GIANTmicrobes' Fat Cell (Adipocyte) keychains, a small plush representation of a human fat cell used for anatomy/nutrition education, marketed for classrooms and gift-giving (clip-on keychain format, per GIANTmicrobes' '-kc' naming convention).
researchResults.source: Wayback Machine capture of giantmicrobes.com/us/products/fat-cell-kc-pack.html (2022-05-25) for name/description; image URL is a separately-archived (2025-06-10) higher-resolution capture of the product photo (verified 200 OK, JPEG, 700x507).
researchResults.notes: The live giantmicrobes.com URL for this product now 404s, but multiple Wayback Machine captures of both the page and its product image exist.

researchResults.name: Fat Cell (Adipocyte) Petri Dish
researchResults.description: A mini-plush version of GIANTmicrobes' Fat Cell (Adipocyte), packaged in the brand's signature petri-dish container as part of their 'Petri Dish' miniature product line.
researchResults.source: Wayback Machine capture of giantmicrobes.com/us/products/fatcell-petri.html (2014-08-11); image URL verified 200 OK, JPEG.

researchResults.name: Father's Day Pack
researchResults.description: A themed gift bundle for Father's Day priced at $49.95, including one GIANTmicrobes coffee mug, one 'Noodle' necktie, and one 'World's Smartest Dad' Brain Cell plush doll.
researchResults.source: Wayback Machine capture of giantmicrobes.com/us/products/fathersdaypack.html (2013-06-07); meta description lists the exact package contents; image URL verified 200 OK, JPEG.

researchResults.name: Feeling Good Medal
researchResults.description: A colorful, antique-gold-plated medal featuring GIANTmicrobes' White Blood Cell design; 2 inches, with a magnetic back (to stick on a fridge) and a clip-on neck strap, packaged in a velvet gift bag.
researchResults.source: Wayback Machine capture of giantmicrobes.com/us/products/feeling-good-medal.html (2019-09-20); page title and meta description confirm product details; image URL verified 200 OK, JPEG.

researchResults.name: Flea (Ctenocephalides felis) Petri Dish
researchResults.description: A mini-plush version of GIANTmicrobes' Flea (cat flea, Ctenocephalides felis) in the brand's petri-dish miniature format; marketed as a gag/educational gift for pet owners and veterinarians about flea parasites.
researchResults.source: Wayback Machine capture of giantmicrobes.com/us/products/flea-petri.html (2014-08-12); also corroborated by a live AMNH Store listing (shop.amnh.org) for the same 'Giant Microbes Flea (Ctenocephalides felis) Petri Dish' product. Image URL verified 200 OK, JPEG.

researchResults.name: Flesh Eating (Streptococcus pyogenes) Petri Dish
researchResults.description: A set of mini GIANTmicrobes plush packaged in a glass petri dish, representing Streptococcus pyogenes, the bacterium responsible for necrotizing fasciitis ("flesh-eating disease") and also strep throat.
researchResults.source: Archived giantmicrobes.com/us/products/flesheating-petri.html (Wayback Machine snapshot 2014-08-11, title/meta description) and its archived product image (2016-04-10 capture)

researchResults.name: GIANTmicrobes Primordial Putty: Flesh Eating
researchResults.description: Primordial Putty polymer-clay product line item: one collectible mini GIANTmicrobes Flesh Eating (Streptococcus pyogenes) figure embedded in putty, packaged with a label explaining the represented microbe.
researchResults.source: Archived giantmicrobes.com/us/products/flesheating-putty.html (Wayback Machine snapshot 2012-11-18, page title 'GIANTmicrobes(R) Primordial Putty: Flesh Eating'), corroborated by GIANTmicrobes Fandom Wiki 'Primordial Putty' page listing Flesh Eating as one of the available characters

researchResults.name: Flu Key Chain

researchResults.name: Flu Key Chain 12 Pack
